snippet.title: Vahrin’s Call | Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Forsaken Realms: Vahrin’s Call releases on PC, July 27th 2026!

Adventure awaits in this narrative driven fantasy action-RPG. The war-torn city of Vahrin stands before you on the brink of collapse and in desperate need of aid. As a mercenary in search of your next…opportunity, will you answer Vahrin’s Call?

Wishlist Vahrin’s Call: https://store.steampowered.com/app/951770/Forsaken_Realms_Vahrins_Call/
